structured.answer: I found where they explain a deposit: there's a card called "פיקדון" in the guide, under "כסף שוטף וקצר". But I never got to read what it says. All I saw was the heading and the word "ריבית", so I'll click that card again another day or ask you to sit with me.

stuck.why: The screen is black and full of boxes. On the right it asks 'מה השאלה שלכם?' with amount fields, and I didn't want to type my money in. It took me a while to find 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' on the left, which is what I came for.

stuck.where: Guide, bottom of screen 3 / top of screen 4
stuck.why: The cards 'חשבון עובר ושב', 'פיקדון' and 'תוכנית חיסכון' were cut off at the bottom. When I scrolled, their text had gone by and I only saw 'ריבית' and 'מוסכמת בריבית'. So I never read what the deposit card says.
It suggests קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית. Those are for working people, or a word I don't know. There's nothing there for someone retired with deposits.
English letters (MSCI World, S&P 500) and lots of 'מדד' cards. Here I felt it wasn't for me, I got tired and stopped.

used: Home page card 'להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
Guide heading 'מדריך' and its line 'כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה'
'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון' – where the money is held and what it's invested in
Group 'כסף שוטף וקצר' with the 'פיקדון' and 'תוכנית חיסכון' cards
Card 'אגרות חוב ממשלתיות' – a loan to the state that returns the money with interest
skimmed: The 'מה השאלה שלכם?' form with the buttons דירה, חתונה, ילד, פרישה
'שאלות שכולם שואלים' – I noticed 'כמה מס משלמים על ריבית מפיקדון?'
skipped: The top menu ('השקעה במדד', 'חברות ומסלולים', etc.)
The search box 'הדביקו שם של מוצר'
All the 'מדד' cards (MSCI, נאסד"ק, S&P 500, ת"א-35/90/125)
unsure_meaning: מדד (in the sense of shares, not prices)
MSCI World, MSCI AC World, S&P 500
בשפה פשוטה: … – the 'simple language' was still words I don't know
'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי' – whose site is it? There's no bank or name I know
not_found: What the 'פיקדון' card itself says – it got lost between screens
A plain sentence saying whether there's something as safe as a deposit that pays more
Who's behind the site – no known bank or official body

findings.what: The deposit cards were cut off between the screens, so I scrolled past them without reading what they say
findings.where: Guide, bottom of screen 3 / top of screen 4

findings.what: 'מאיפה להתחיל' only sends you to products for employees or to קרן כספית; nothing for a retiree who has deposits
English letters and lots of 'מדד' make it feel like a stock market site, not a savings site
The first screen asks for amounts of money before it explains anything
Black background with grey writing; the small lines under the headings are hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: All screens, especially 'המוצר עצמו: חשבון בבנק…' and 'בכל עמוד של מוצר…'

findings.what: It's not clear who's behind the site; 'אתר אישי' doesn't give me confidence
findings.where: Under the heading 'מקור' and in the footer
